shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on an upright rectangular slab
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figural carving on a tall rectangular field, including profile creatures and a band of repeated motifs, plus areas of hatched/scale-like surface texture. But A depicts a single large naturalistically proportioned standing human figure in profile with a fish-skin cloak, bucket and cone, while B shows a crowded assemblage of small schematic animals, birds, a snake and abstract signs in registers with no dominant human figure, so the specific subjects, relationships and conventions differ almost entirely.
